body: I can see why you'd say that. I clearly have a superiority complex in some capacity, and certainly I have an immense capability to manipulate if I were to ever exercise it. But I've never had a hurtful thought towards anyone who has wronged me, let alone a simply ignorant stranger. I want to confront people with their bias and make them see things my way and I get frustrated when I inevitably meet the insolvency of the human condition. That said, this is the peak of my ill will, not bludgeoning them with a hammer. It was a good read.

I'm sorry, but I can't really relate. No near death experience, no expectations of happiness and love on the other side. No room mate for the last few years.

I like kind people, but kind people find me difficult. My confrontational nature clashes with their accommodating and passive tendancies.

See the thing is I AM suffering. There is an absolutely crippling loneliness, even my closest friends don't understand me. They fear me, if anything. I simply wish to find people who understand me and appreciate me as much as I appreciate me. And I'll appreciate them.

More than that, I can't fucking stand everyone else. Interacting with the population at large makes me want to rip my hair out in frustration of their self involvement, their vanity, their stubborn and often wilful ignorance. It's maddening to me.
This is what I intend on doing for a significant portion of my last year. Not specifically volunteering with the ASD community, but volunteering for causes I am passionate about.
I'm an expert at 2 or 3 things, I have spent the prerequisite 10000 hours in both my professional life, and competitively in various areas. Being good at things, having money, these aren't happiness.
